title: About Us
description: Who Turkelite Medcare is, what we coordinate, what independent providers remain responsible for, and how commercial relationships are disclosed.

hero.lead: A medical-travel coordination platform designed to connect international patients with selected independent providers in Turkey.
hero.headline: About Us

intro.what_we_do: Turkelite Medcare coordinates the practical journey around treatment delivered by independent providers in Turkey: treatment research, provider communication, scheduling, travel planning, arrival logistics and return-home handover.
intro.what_we_do_not: Turkelite Medcare is not a hospital or medical provider. It does not diagnose, prescribe, decide suitability, obtain clinical consent or perform treatment. Those responsibilities remain with the independent licensed provider.

hero_card.text: One team coordinating the journey around your care

transparency.heading: How we are paid
paragraphs: You should know who pays us before you rely on anything we tell you. Ask us directly and we will answer in writing who pays our fee, whether it differs between clinics, and whether any clinic can pay to be featured.

What we will commit to in public: a clinic's commercial terms with us never decide whether it is clinically right for you. Suitability is the treating clinician's judgement, and we do not overrule it or route around it.

summary.heading: Three clear roles

items.why: The procedure must fit your clinical situation, not simply your preference.
items.decision: Is this procedure suitable for me?
items.coordination: We organise the records and questions the partner clinic asks for, so the clinical review can actually happen.

items.why: Quotes can look similar while covering different treatment, facility and aftercare items.
items.coordination: We structure the clinic proposal so inclusions, exclusions and practical extras are comparable.

items.why: Clinical dates and recovery requirements should determine the journey, not the other way round.
items.coordination: We sequence flights, transfers and accommodation around the clinic-confirmed plan.

items.why: Follow-up should not become unclear once you leave Turkey.
items.coordination: We make the handover, contact route and provider instructions visible before departure.

decisions.heading: The four decisions that should have an owner

experience.text: Every stage has a clear owner, a clear output, and a clear point at which clinical responsibility stays with the treating provider.
experience.heading: What the patient actually experiences

quotations.note: A firm price can only follow clinical assessment. Any figure before a clinician reviews your case is an estimate and can change.
quotations.text: Before a treatment journey is ready to book, each of these should have a clear answer and a clear owner.
quotations.cost_text: Every clinic proposal should be broken down against the same checklist, so quotations can be compared on the same terms.
